relationship.description: Legacy input. New models use the four separate layers in workspace.options.
relationship.title: Relationship

model_families.name: Business to business
model_families.definition: An organization buys; users and approvers can differ.
model_families.metrics: Sales cycle, annual contract value, retention
model_families.first_test: Identify the budget owner and test a paid pilot.

model_families.name: Business to consumer
model_families.definition: An individual buys for personal use.
model_families.first_test: Test an offer at a real price with a narrow audience.

model_families.name: Consumer to consumer
model_families.definition: Individuals exchange value with each other.
model_families.metrics: Match rate, time to match, disputes
model_families.first_test: Test one category with verified participants.

model_families.name: Business to business to consumer
model_families.definition: A partner buys, embeds or distributes access for end users.
model_families.first_test: Test partner commitment and end-user activation separately.

model_families.name: Direct to consumer
model_families.definition: A producer sells directly to consumers.
model_families.first_test: Test paid orders including acquisition and delivery costs.

model_families.name: Marketplace
model_families.definition: Coordinate supply, demand, trust and transactions.
model_families.first_test: Manually fulfill one dense segment before expanding.

model_families.name: API / platform
model_families.definition: Others build on a repeatable programmable capability.
model_families.metrics: Active integrations, time to value, reliability
model_families.first_test: Test a paid design-partner integration.

model_families.name: Franchise
model_families.definition: Operators license a repeatable brand and operating system.
model_families.first_test: Prove company-operated unit economics first.

model_families.name: Wholesale
model_families.definition: Sell in volume to resellers or institutions.
model_families.first_test: Test small orders and payment terms.

model_families.name: Retail
model_families.definition: Sell through physical or digital storefronts.
model_families.first_test: Test a narrow catalogue or pop-up.

model_families.name: Manufacturing
model_families.definition: Transform inputs and control production quality and capacity.
model_families.first_test: Test prototypes and paid pilot orders.

model_families.name: SaaS
model_families.definition: Deliver ongoing access to a software workflow.
model_families.first_test: Test repeated use and paid renewal.

model_families.name: Licensing
model_families.definition: Grant defined rights to use intellectual property.
model_families.first_test: Test a standard scope with one customer.

model_families.name: Data / insights
model_families.definition: Deliver lawful, current, decision-relevant information.
model_families.first_test: Test a paid insight and its effect on a decision.

model_families.name: AI as a Service
model_families.definition: Deliver a bounded model-assisted capability.
model_families.first_test: Compare a real task with a human baseline.

model_families.name: Subscription
model_families.definition: Charge repeatedly for continuing value.
model_families.first_test: Test renewal after actual use.

model_families.name: Freemium
model_families.definition: Offer a free tier with an explicit paid conversion trigger.
model_families.first_test: Test the paywall with activated users.

model_families.name: Usage based
model_families.definition: Charge for measurable consumption.
model_families.metrics: Revenue and margin per unit, bill predictability
model_families.first_test: Test metering and customer comprehension.

model_families.name: Per user
model_families.definition: Charge for authorized or active seats.
model_families.first_test: Test who needs access and a second paid seat.

model_families.name: Commission / take rate
model_families.definition: Keep a share of transacted value.
model_families.first_test: Test whether trust and workflow justify the fee.

model_families.name: Transaction fee
model_families.definition: Charge for a completed transaction or event.
model_families.first_test: Test a real transaction with total cost visible.

model_families.name: Lead generation
model_families.definition: Charge for an agreed qualified prospect.
model_families.first_test: Agree qualification rules and track outcomes.

model_families.name: Advertising
model_families.definition: Advertisers pay for access to an audience.
model_families.first_test: Test a disclosed sponsor and user response.

model_families.name: Outcome based
model_families.definition: Charge against a verified result and agreed baseline.
model_families.first_test: Test measurement and settlement for one outcome.

model_families.name: Hybrid
model_families.definition: Combine explicit streams while keeping each stream's economics visible.
model_families.metrics: Revenue mix, margin by stream, complexity
model_families.first_test: Test each stream before testing the bundle.

patterns.cannot_prove: Demand, reliability or willingness to pay

patterns.description: Measure a real offer response with availability clearly disclosed.
Offer clear delivery/refund terms before taking a commitment.
Operate a bounded paid or unpaid trial with stated criteria.
Assemble only the workflow needed for measurement.
Run the job directly with a small participant group.
Build one feature tied to one observable outcome.
